name: motionprep-studio
description: Prepare images and books as animation-ready layered assets.

scripts.benchmark:ocr: npm run build --workspace @motionprep/contracts && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/presets && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/document-processing && node --conditions=production scripts/benchmark-ocr.mjs
scripts.benchmark:ocr:corpus: npm run build --workspace @motionprep/contracts && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/presets && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/document-processing && node --conditions=production scripts/benchmark-ocr-corpus.mjs --write-report --summary
scripts.benchmark:ocr:development: npm run build --workspace @motionprep/contracts && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/presets && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/document-processing && node --conditions=production scripts/benchmark-ocr-corpus.mjs --exclude-holdout --summary
scripts.golden:adobe:generate: npm run build --workspace @motionprep/contracts && npm run build --workspace @motionprep/export-adapters && node --conditions=production scripts/generate-adobe-golden.mjs
scripts.verify:fixtures: node --test scripts/ocr-corpus-wikitext.test.mjs scripts/ocr-holdout-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-fixture-corpus.mjs && node scripts/verify-ocr-corpus.mjs --allow-stale-implementation-when-disabled
scripts.quality: npm run verify:architecture && npm run verify:deployment && npm run verify:recovery && npm run verify:release-env:test && npm run verify:release-evidence:test && npm run test:load:utils && npm run verify:clean && npm run verify:css && npm run verify:fixtures && npm run verify:visuals && npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run deadcode && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm run build && npm run verify:bundle
